nodes.label: ADR-022 Conditional chapter-five completeness
nodes.summary: Accepted 2026-10-07: land and existing-permit conditions control active fields; only core details count as required; optional documents and hidden data are preserved.
nodes.rationale: All-fields-required logic incorrectly rejected drafts when supporting permits or their documents were unavailable.
nodes.status: Accepted; completeness concerns assistance documents, not legal permit obligations
nodes.evidence_scope: Documented product/architecture decision; does not independently verify current code

nodes.label: Chapter-five land and existing-permit activation
nodes.summary: land_relation=adjacent activates land proof; has_existing_permits=true activates permit details; both inactive skips chapter; explicit preview selection confirmed to root payload.
nodes.rationale: Existing-permit state should remain one shared condition across wizard, snapshot, review and export.

nodes.label: Required versus optional permit and land fields
nodes.summary: Permit required type/year/status; land required status/evidence type/year; document, notes and other permit details optional; preserve all filled active fields and legacy-flat payload.
nodes.rationale: Missing optional attachments must not mark otherwise complete supporting detail incomplete.

nodes.label: Inactive evidence preservation and snapshot exclusion
nodes.summary: No-permit choice hides fields and excludes inactive data from snapshots/documents without deleting existing edits or private recognized-anchor attachments; unknown anchors still error.
nodes.rationale: Support users with no permits while retaining work if conditions change later.

nodes.label: Transactional chapter-five condition confirmation
nodes.summary: Lock and read latest proposal, atomically save condition/data/checkpoint; ignore preview condition if chapter-one decision changed since checkpoint; AI cannot guess/change condition.
nodes.rationale: Prevent cross-tab stale previews from overwriting the shared condition or inventing permits.
